definitions.explanation: The act of adding a substance to something, typically in a technical, industrial, or food science context. Most commonly refers to adding chemicals, preservatives, flavoring, or other substances to food or products.

examples.japanese: {添加|てんか}{物|ぶつ}が{入|はい}っていない。
{食品|しょくひん}{添加|てんか}{物|ぶつ}の{安全性|あんぜんせい}が{問題|もんだい}になっている。
examples.english: The safety of food additives has become an issue.

examples.japanese: この{製品|せいひん}には{人工|じんこう}{着色料|ちゃくしょくりょう}や{保存料|ほぞんりょう}を{添加|てんか}していません。
examples.english: No artificial coloring or preservatives have been added to this product.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly encountered in the compound {添加|てんか}{物|ぶつ} (additive), especially {食品|しょくひん}{添加|てんか}{物|ぶつ} (food additive). This is by far the most frequent context for this word.

Not to be confused with the homophone {天下|てんか} (the world, the realm).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {添加|てんか}{物|ぶつ}: additive
- {食品|しょくひん}{添加|てんか}{物|ぶつ}: food additive
- {無|む}{添加|てんか}: additive-free, no additives
- {添加|てんか}{物|ぶつ}{不使用|ふしよう}: no additives used
- {添加|てんか}{剤|ざい}: additive agent
